reviews.text:
Incredibly hydrating and soothing. My skin instantly feels plump, refreshed, and prepped for the rest of my routine.
​I love that they are dual-textured. The textured side is perfect for a gentle, daily exfoliation, while the smooth side is great for wiping away any remaining impurities or leaving on my cheeks for a few minutes like a mini sheet mask.
reviews.zh:
保濕同舒緩效果超好。我嘅皮膚即刻飽滿、清新，為之後嘅護膚步驟做好準備。
我好鍾意佢係雙質地設計。有紋理嗰面好適合每日溫和去角質，而光滑嗰面就好適合抹走殘餘嘅污垢，或者喺面頰上留幾分鐘，好似迷你面膜咁。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using these essence pads consistently and love how hydrated and refreshed my skin feels after each use. The pads are generously soaked with essence and leave my skin looking plump, smooth, and radiant without feeling sticky.
I like using them after cleansing to add an extra layer of hydration before the rest of my skincare routine. They help my skin feel softer and give me a healthy glow, especially on days when my complexion looks dull or tired.
The large pad size is convenient, and the gentle formula works well for my mature skin. Definitely a great addition to my routine for hydration and glow.
reviews.zh:
我一直都有用呢啲精華化妝棉，每次用完都好鍾意皮膚嘅水潤同清爽感覺。化妝棉充分吸滿精華，用完皮膚睇落飽滿、順滑、有光澤，而且唔會黏黏地。
我通常潔面之後用，喺其他護膚程序之前多一層水分補充。尤其係膚色睇落暗淡或者疲倦嗰啲日子，佢幫皮膚感覺更柔軟，亦令皮膚有健康嘅光澤。
化妝棉大塊，好方便，而且溫和嘅配方適合我嘅熟齡皮膚。絕對係我日常補水同提亮嘅好選擇。

reviews.text: These essence pads are generously soaked and feel very refreshing on the skin. I love using them after cleansing for an extra boost of hydration and radiance. My skin looks smoother, brighter, and more glowy after use, and the large pad size makes it easy to cover the entire face. They are gentle, comfortable, and work well under the rest of my skincare and makeup. A great addition to my routine, especially for achieving healthy-looking, hydrated skin.
reviews.zh: 呢啲精華化妝棉充分吸滿精華，用落皮膚好清爽。我好鍾意潔面後用，額外補充水分同光澤。用完之後皮膚睇落更順滑、更光亮、更有光澤，而且大塊嘅化妝棉好易覆蓋成張面。佢哋溫和、舒適，喺其他護膚同化妝步驟之下用都好夾。係我日常護理嘅好選擇，特別適合想要健康、水潤膚質嘅人。

reviews.text:
These Essence Pad has been a delightful addition to my skincare routine. These essence pads have proven to be a game-changer in achieving a radiant and luminous complexion. They are designed to be gentle on the skin, allowing for a comfortable and soothing experience.

I’ve noticed a distinct improvement in my skin’s overall texture and tone after regular use. The essence is absorbed quickly, leaving a subtle but noticeable glow. It’s particularly effective in hydrating and rejuvenating dull or tired-looking skin.
reviews.zh:
呢款 Essence 化妝棉令我嘅護膚程序多咗一個令人開心嘅步驟。呢啲精華化妝棉喺打造有光澤、明亮膚色方面，證明係一個改變遊戲規則嘅產品。佢設計得溫和，令你用得舒適、有舒緩感。

我經常使用之後，覺得皮膚整體質地同膚色都有明顯改善。精華吸收得快，留下淡淡但睇得出嘅光澤。佢特別有效於補充水分，同令暗淡或者疲倦嘅皮膚重新煥發活力。

reviews.text: After using western skincare products, they broke my skin barrier. Fourtunately, i could detect it on time and now im using Numbuzin’s products, i use this alongside Numbuzin Number 3 serum and omg my new holy grail. I leave this on my skin as a sheet mask and it leaves my skin squishy and soft. This time difference was only in 5 days, can’t wait to see more results in a month.
reviews.zh: 用過西方護膚品之後，我嘅皮膚屏障受損咗。好彩我及時發現，而家我用緊 Numbuzin 嘅產品，呢款會同 Numbuzin 3 號精華一齊用，真係我嘅新 holy grail（最愛）。我會留喺皮膚上當面膜敷，敷完皮膚軟綿綿、柔軟。只係五日就已經有咁大嘅分別，好期待一個月之後會有更多效果。

reviews.text: I like to use these like toner pads in the morning and oh my golly geezers have these cleared my skin. I used to have a TOOOOON of acne scars and milia around my nose but I started using this along with the blemish serum and how my skin is so clear??? It is like literal glass. guys this is a must but the pads are pretty thin which i don't have a problem with so yeah! 🗣️🗣️
reviews.zh: 我朝早會當化妝棉咁用呢啲，哇，呢啲真係令我皮膚清晒！我之前鼻周有好多痘印同粟粒疹（milia），但我開始同去痘精華一齊用之後，我嘅皮膚點解可以咁清？？真係好似玻璃咁。大家一定要買，不過棉片幾薄，但我冇乜問題，咁啱啦！ 🗣️🗣️

reviews.text: I have sensitive and acne-prone skin. Therefore, I am so careful in choosing and applying any product to my face. However, I decided to buy this toner as I watched many positive testimonies in YouTube. At first I was afraid to try it to my skin. However, after I used it for the first time, it really hydrated my skin. Plus, the toner also makes my skin looks glowing. Wow! Can't wait to know how my skin will be if I using it for 1 week 😁✌️
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚敏感又易長痘，所以選擇同塗抹任何產品都好小心。不過，我喺 YouTube 見到好多正面分享，所以決定買呢款化妝水。一開始我都驚試喺皮膚上。不過，第一次用完之後，真係好補濕。而且化妝水仲令皮膚睇落有光澤。哇！好想知用咗一個星期之後皮膚會變成點 😁✌️

reviews.text: This is amazing, by far the best toner I've used. I also purchased the toner bottle from this brand and I would say this is the best product to travel or you're on the time crunch. Since all the pads are already soaked up with the toner it save you so much time apply it on your skin. I love using this in the morning since I always wake up late and never have enough time to do my regular routine but this product has saved me so much time and it makes your skin looks flawless.
reviews.zh: 真係好正，係我用過最好嘅化妝水。我仲買咗呢個品牌嘅化妝水瓶裝，我會話呢款最適合外出旅行，或者時間好趕嘅時候用。因為化妝棉已經吸滿化妝水，所以塗喺皮膚上好快好方便。我最鍾意朝早用，因為我總係起身好遲，冇足夠時間做日常護理，但呢款產品幫咗我省好多時間，而且令你皮膚睇落完美無瑕。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
